port.title: Port
port.end_flangedFree: One end flanged, the other free (default)
port.endHelp: Flanged end: the opening sits flush against a flat surface, such as the box wall. Free end: the tube ends in open air. Each finish changes the end correction and, with it, the port length needed for the same tuning.
port.placement_auto: In a row with the driver
port.placementManual: Custom: port moved by hand in the cut plan
port.cornersHint: B and H are the legs against the walls. Bottom corners first; each port is closed by a diagonal board.
port.cornersTooMany: Up to 4 ports fit in the corners: with more, they are placed freely on the panel.

drivers.title: Drivers
drivers.coilsLabel: Voice coil wiring of the dual voice coil driver ({{variant}})

signal.title: Signal
signal.radiationHelp: Only changes the predicted level (SPL), not the box tuning. Half space (2π) assumes the box sits against a large surface that reflects sound forward: the level is 6 dB above free space (4π), where the box hangs in the air away from everything. For car audio or a box on the floor, use half space.
signal.halfHint: Box on the floor, in a trunk or against a wall (+6 dB level).
signal.fullHint: Box hanging in the air, away from surfaces, like a lab measurement.
signal.abovePe: Above the combined thermal power of the drivers ({{limit}}).

dims.hint: Letters follow the sketch. The cutout (C) and the motor volume (M-Vd) are the same fields as in the cut plan and the simulation.

ai.title: AI box suggestion
ai.intro: The AI proposes up to three boxes for this driver, based on usage and priority. Each option is simulated by BuildBass before it shows: the numbers are the simulator's, not the AI's.
ai.maxVolumeHint: Optional. The space you have available.
ai.unusable: Does not fit: the port takes too much volume or no net volume is left. It cannot be applied.
ai.loud: High port air speed at the project's power: there may be port noise.
ai.disclaimer: AI suggestions can be wrong. Check the curves after applying; one undo brings everything back.
ai.applied: AI suggestion applied: {{title}} (Vb {{vb}}). One undo restores the previous box.
